audit_method.closure_derivation: Union of acquired_qc_passed and acquired_qc_failed prior closed-batch outcomes/cache checks plus current acquired outcomes, frozen before file verification and independently matched to receipt execution-source run identities. Acquisition counts include the retained QC-failed case.
checks: frozen TRAIN role and full index identity
original byte sizes and MD5/source SHA256/receipt SHA256
retained execution-source records and source snapshots
strict recorded time and source-size budget
retained session and per-image QC failures

closure.remaining_people_meaning: People with no acquired session; partial-person pending visits are listed separately.
closure.meaning: Verified original-byte acquisition totals, including QC-failed originals.

newly_acquired.people_meaning: Distinct people represented in the new sessions; new_unique_people is the additional person credit.

batch_accounting.distinction: 13 not verified in this batch includes 0 previously acquired sessions not revisited before the deadline. Cumulative unacquired remaining is 13. QC failure remains separate from unacquired status.

bounds.byte_accounting: source-size budget, not measured network transfer

cleanup_verification.method: Read-only process table check for process groups matching recorded supervised worker PIDs; workers start new sessions.

leftover_snapshot_scope: Filesystem leftovers reflect the audit timestamp after batch31 closed, not a reconstructed snapshot at closure. Later batches may be running or already finished. Resumed partials may have grown or completed after closure. Receipt membership was snapshotted before byte verification; later receipts may appear during the audit. Complete files lacking a receipt in that snapshot are excluded even if a later receipt exists by the leftover scan.

claim_limits.note: Byte/receipt integrity and saved QC consistency only. QC-passed modality counts do not establish clinical, anatomical, source-frame, spatial or learning eligibility.
